scenario: Scripted fleet of uav-01 Eagle-1, uav-02 Eagle-2, ugv-01 Wolf-1, ugv-02 Wolf-2. One HTTP operator and one /ws/cop client. Cruise, then NATS outage, one adapter stop, Redis outage, and a process restart.

evidence.mission_actor_note: Mission start issues GOTO with actor mission. Operator HTTP commands use operator:op-1.

faults.name: nats_down
faults.expected: The GOTO stays pending while NATS is down, then the outbox publishes it once and the adapter executes it once after NATS returns.
faults.actual: HTTP status pending result {'queued': True}. After NATS listened again, command status was sent result {'ack': True}, outbox published_at 2026-10-13 02:05:54.655964, attempts 1, recall {'ok': True, 'reason': ''}, sim target {'lat': 17.42, 'lon': 78.52, 'alt': 0.0}.

faults.name: adapter_stop
faults.expected: The stopped vehicle is marked lost and an Alert is raised.
faults.actual: Immediately after stop, asset status was offline and the friendly track state was active. After 32s, asset status was lost and track state was lost. Alerts whose text contains lost: 2. New alerts since the stop: 1.

lost_alerts.title: Asset lost
lost_alerts.message: Wolf-2 is offline and its track is lost

faults.name: redis_down
faults.expected: With Redis unreachable, the picture keeps serving from the operator store. After Redis returns, the overlay ping succeeds again.
faults.actual: After Redis was stopped, a HOLD still produced an HTTP 200 and the socket frame contained 4 fleet assets (redis_down flag True). uav-01 moved about 0.0 m on that frame relative to the pre-outage fix. Storage backend for this process is duckdb. cop_frame does not query Postgres. After Redis was started again, redis_down flag was False and the socket still had 4 fleet assets.

faults.name: process_restart
faults.expected: After the process restarts, operator state is restored.
faults.actual: Restart loaded assets ['uav-01', 'uav-02', 'ugv-01', 'ugv-02'] (all expected: True) and missions ['86bddd2d-1886-48a4-be21-d63542ba6006'] (all expected: True). Tracks still present: 5.
